relevance_note: Case report of a man with early-onset Blau syndrome and a NOD2 variant ("the M513T mutation in the NOD2 was identified"), plus four previously reported BS patients with pulmonary lesions summarised individually in the Discussion.
method_note: Hand-built from a full reading of the paper; a Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON and checked every span verbatim. Scope: the present patient plus four previously reported BS patients with pulmonary lesions listed individually in the Discussion (sex, age, NOD2 variant). Two of them carry printed references ((6), (3)); two have no reference printed, so they are labelled 'unnamed person 1' (2 years 7 months, R334Q) and 'unnamed person 2' (2 years, R334W) with source_reference 'not reported'. The 'nineteen-year-old male of this presenting with M513T' in the Discussion is taken as the present patient; CONTRADICTION: the case presentation says 'a 22-years-old man', the Discussion 'nineteen-year-old'; 22 recorded as age at report (age at referral). cites_prior_report set true from 'the M513T mutation in the NOD2 was identified and previously reported (2)', which may refer to the variant finding rather than the patient (ambiguous). Group-level mentions not given rows: iPSC donors with R334W (11, 12), the patient with P. acnes on skin (9). Interstitial lung disease for ref (3) patient is linked through the citation '(3)' on 'the first case of interstitial lung disease in BS was reported in 2007 (3)'; for the present patient the paper describes pulmonary granulomas and granular shadows but never calls them interstitial lung disease, so that checklist item is 'not reported'. Admission body temperature 36.3°C was not used to exclude fever (a single reading). Normal heart/lung auscultation recorded as written (D-27) without excluding anything more specific. Functional evidence (similar NF-κB activation among R334Q, R334W and M513T, ref 7) attached to those exact variants. 'R334 Q' kept as printed for ref (3) patient. The paper reports 'worsening arthralgia on the day X+4' in one place and X+4M elsewhere; not used as a value. The ref (6) case 'recommended the use of prednisolone and immunosuppressive agents', a recommendation, not recorded as treatment.
